title: What is BODMAS? Full Form, Rule, Left-to-Right Trap, 'Of' and Worked Examples
seoTitle: What is BODMAS? Rule, Full Form and Examples
seoDescription: BODMAS is the order to solve maths sums: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. See the left-to-right rule and solved examples.
excerpt: Why 24 ÷ 4 × 2 is 12, how 'of' works in SSC and bank sums, the order for removing bars and brackets, what Ganita Prakash teaches instead, and the honest answer to the viral 6 ÷ 2(1 + 2) puzzle.
